exposure: prophylactic Caesarean iliac artery balloon insertion
cohort: 23 patients with abnormal placental implantation (high-grade placenta praevia and/or placenta accreta) who underwent prophylactic Caesarean iliac artery balloon insertion.
finding: Prophylactic Caesarean iliac artery balloon insertion in patients with abnormal placental implantation is feasible and safe, with comparable obstetric outcomes to data published in the literature.
